summary: East Redonda Island is a coastal island in British Columbia, Canada, belonging to the Discovery Islands archipelago. The note places it just north of Desolation Sound Marine Park, off the north end of the Malaspina Peninsula at the mouth of Toba Inlet. It lies within Electoral Area C of the Strathcona Regional District.
one_line: East Redonda Island is a coastal island in British Columbia's Discovery Islands, located north of Desolation Sound Marine Park.
key_facts: East Redonda Island is a coastal island in British Columbia, Canada.
East Redonda Island is part of the Discovery Islands archipelago.
East Redonda Island lies just to the north of Desolation Sound Marine Park.
Desolation Sound Marine Park is located off the north end of the Malaspina Peninsula.
Desolation Sound Marine Park is located at the mouth of Toba Inlet.
Desolation Sound Marine Park is within Electoral Area C of the Strathcona Regional District.
